# UBDetsurf Industries Pvt. Ltd.

> UBDetsurf Industries Pvt. Ltd. is a Noida-based manufacturer of emulsifiers, surfactants, wetting and dispersing agents and adjuvants for agrochemical (crop-protection) formulations. The company states that it has worked in this field since 2009.

This file is a plain-language guide to the public website. It summarises information published on the pages below; the pages themselves are the source of truth.

## Company facts (summarised from across the website)
- Legal name: UBDetsurf Industries Pvt. Ltd. (UBDetsurf Industries Private Limited)
- Head office: Ithum, Tower-B, 1111A, Plot No. A-40, Sector-62, Noida, Uttar Pradesh - 201301, India
- Business: emulsifiers, surfactants, wetting and dispersing agents and adjuvants for agrochemical formulations
- Customers: agrochemical manufacturers and formulators in India
- Manufacturing: two units; a third is planned
  - Unit 1: G-517, UPSIDC Industrial Area, MG Road, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh 201015
  - Unit 2: G-26, Hapur Road, UPSIDC Industrial Area, Udyog Kunj, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh 201001
- Certificates published: ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, ISO 45001:2018 (issued by Care Certification Pvt. Ltd., valid until 28 July 2029)
- Directors named on the site: Umesh Gupta (Marketing & Operations), B.K. Gupta (Technology & Business Development)
- Contact: infosales@ubdetsurf.com (domestic market), exim@ubdetsurf.com (international market), hrrrgroup3@gmail.com (job applications), 0120-4136200 (office)

## Pages
- [Home](https://www.ubdetsurf.com/): overview, product groups, FAQ
- [About us](https://www.ubdetsurf.com/about-us.html): company story, leadership, journey, vision and mission, facilities
- [Products](https://www.ubdetsurf.com/products.html): formulation types (EC, EW, SC, SL, WP/WDG, SG) with molecule recommendation tables and notes
- [Research & development](https://www.ubdetsurf.com/research-development.html): lab capabilities and the development process
- [Our clients](https://www.ubdetsurf.com/clients.html): agrochemical companies supplied
- [Certifications](https://www.ubdetsurf.com/iso-certifications.html): ISO certificates with numbers and validity
- [Careers](https://www.ubdetsurf.com/careers.html): how to apply by email
- [Contact](https://www.ubdetsurf.com/contact-us.html): enquiry details

## Notes for readers
- Product recommendations on the Products page are based on ideal laboratory conditions; dosages and ratios vary with the formulation and technical material, so they are shared on request.
- No prices, technical data sheets or safety data sheets are published on the website.
